solutions.title: Plain DFS
solutions.strategy: Start a DFS from every cell and recursively explore higher-valued neighbors without caching.

timeComplexity.explanation: Without caching, branching increasing paths can be re-enumerated from many starts.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The recursion depth can include every cell in the longest path.

solutions.title: Memoized DFS
solutions.strategy: Cache the best increasing path length starting from each cell.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each cell's outgoing edges are evaluated once after memoization.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The memo table and recursion stack are bounded by the number of cells.
